comments.text:
Hi Investing Sucks,

Have you read "Analysis and Valuation of Insurance Companies" by Columbia Business School and Ernst & Young?

They talk about Net Equity Flow (NEF) being the true return that common shareholders experience over the life of an insurance company.

The formula: NEF = Comprehensive Income to Common LESS Current Year Common Equity PLUS Previous Year Common Equity.

Let me know, curious to your thoughts on this.
TG
